provenance: Owned synthetic DiagramML, regenerated in the native reference application on 2026-10-11. Expected native drawing geometry in EMU and displayed font sizes in points. Browser glyph inputs were refreshed after complete-span shaping and are actual app measurements, independent of the rule-fitting implementation. Duplicate-name v1 controls were rejected as evidence. v2 has unique layout names. Nested/leaf-rule and ch-font-selector execution remain explicit diagnostics; width-first font now matches native after complete-span shaping. No reference-application drawing/style/font assets are included. Three preceding native overflow controls retain exhausted/inactive font limits and deliberately report fits:false; their complete bounds and fonts independently match the actual browser. Twenty-four new owned customized-ancestor controls have independent native bounds, displayed fonts and body margins, all four LIN directions, derived geometry, fractional authored fonts and automatic/custom peers. They deliberately retain physical overflow. Expected numeric primary fonts round the native first-character size to whole points; authored displayed sizes remain separately recorded. Rejected malformed fractional v1 probes are excluded.
